rule: 0DTE ATM call at every flat open; transform when the 0DTE affords one monthly ATM (all proceeds); exit on first daily close below the previous candle's low
transform_day_exit_convention: exit arms next day (pre-trigger low/close unusable)
description: 0DTE proof -> monthly transform -> prev-low close exit (the H3 pipeline): every flat day buy a 0DTE ATM call at the open (premium = the whole risk); at the FIRST intraday price where the 0DTE's model value pays for one monthly ATM call (real-time affordability, --transform-trigger afford: the required move floats with vol/tenor), all proceeds roll into a monthly ATM call at the trigger price, sold on the first daily CLOSE below the previous candle's low (--transform-exit prevlow) with ATM re-strikes at each monthly expiry; the exit sells at model value. r is in proof-premium multiples (-1 = the premium, the whole risk).
note: BSM-priced both legs; transform fill pessimistically AT the trigger; the exit arms from the day AFTER the transform (intraday order vs the trigger is unknowable on daily OHLC); daily proof spend = 1% of equity per attempt.
